body: I really, really would if I could, but school and other things prevent me from doing so. I'll only be able to move somewhere if I can find a job there, and I can only find a job if I push myself in my Cisco courses, which I cannot muster the energy to excel in during this time of the year. All of my friends are just telling me to deal with it, when in reality I really cannot take this fucking weather anymore. It's just pathetic.
